countsAndDenominators.totalDrives: Handler.go:123-136 counts all completed, positive-distance drives whose started_at is inside the full UTC year. No limit/offset/page-local total. Active/zero-distance drives are deliberately excluded.
countsAndDenominators.totalCharges: Handler.go:171-181 counts all completed charging sessions whose started_at is inside the full UTC year. Monthly and connector aggregations use the same calendar bounds.
countsAndDenominators.monthly: Handler.go:266-326 constructs all twelve months in month order. Missing months are zero-filled; failed secondary aggregations are not distinguished from no activity (F04).
countsAndDenominators.weekly: Handler.go:358-374 divides past-year drives by 52; current-year drives by elapsed UTC weeks, with a one-week minimum. Future-year elapsed<=0 keeps 52. Not a uniform full-calendar-year denominator (F05).
countsAndDenominators.distancePerDrive: Handler.go:376-379 divides total distance by the same qualifying completed positive-distance drive count, guarding zero count.
countsAndDenominators.efficiency: Handler.go:147-165 uses unweighted AVG of per-drive Wh/km, only distance>1609.344m and energy_used_wh>0. It is not total-energy/total-distance fleet efficiency; no qualifying observations become 0.
countsAndDenominators.chargingMix: Handler.go:386-427 computes percentage of successfully counted completed sessions, not energy share. Tesla-prefixed charger_type is Supercharger; every other non-null type is DC fast; null is AC/other. Physical connector classification accuracy is not established by source-only inspection.
countsAndDenominators.plugInSoc: Handler.go:429-436 excludes valid 0% observations and COALESCEs no qualifying average to 0 (F07).
countsAndDenominators.coverage: No observation-coverage denominator, error/partial metadata or timezone is returned. Page brief explicitly says coverage is not reported; it does not claim measured completeness.

Monthly drives/distance chart with energy table column, retained legend state/export; charging connector mix with session/SOC caption, legend and table alternative; fleet recovery action.

Savings plus gas/electric bars and coffee estimate; environment plus tree estimate; favorite day/peak hour and weekly/distance/efficiency averages. Current data path no longer duplicates outer impact LayoutCard chrome.
Four record shells, addresses/date/distance/duration/efficiency and three extreme metrics. Producer defects/unavailable efficient records do not mean the page deleted the sections.
Comparison list/card grid with server labels/values and decorative emojis; explicit optional-empty placeholder.
Vehicle/year identity, five recap metrics, positive savings summary and original screenshot guidance; independently gated AI narration. No invented screenshot-download feature.

confirmedFindings.mechanism: driveHighlight has no JSON tags. httpx/json.go:16-21 uses ordinary encoding/json, so populated records serialize DriveID/Date/DistanceKm/DurationS/StartAddress/EndAddress/EfficiencyWhKm. api/types.ts:2835-2844 and YearDriveRecord.tsx:22-26,35-45 expect drive_id/date/distance_km/duration_min/start_address/end_address/efficiency_wh_km. resilience.ts:23-41 only adds snake->camel aliases, not Pascal->snake. Duration is additionally seconds versus expected minutes. A populated record therefore reads as zero distance/duration and absent addresses/date/efficiency.

Page numeric metrics then render measured zero speed and 0 degrees, defeating the correct frontend missing-value guard. Zero Celsius is a valid observation, not an absence marker.

confirmedFindings.mechanism: Secondary monthly/efficiency/pattern/type/SOC queries may fail after headline success. Preinitialized zero months/default values remain, several query or Scan failures are ignored, and the handler still emits HTTP 200 without partial/error provenance. Frontend useDataState consequently treats the payload as recorded/available evidence, not a retained refresh error or partial source. Successful no-activity and failed computation become indistinguishable.

confirmedFindings.mechanism: avg_drives_per_week uses fixed 52 for completed calendar years, elapsed UTC weeks for the current year and a one-week floor, while the response/UI describes calendar-year averages without exposing that denominator. A full non-leap/leap year has 365/7 or 366/7 weeks, not exactly 52. This is a confirmed mixed denominator/interpretation boundary, not a page-local count defect.

confirmedFindings.needs: Declare and preserve the intended full-year versus elapsed-year denominator and its scope; parent must decide any behavior change before source edits.
confirmedFindings.evidenceLimit: Formula and absent denominator metadata confirmed; desired product policy and runtime values are not inferred.

confirmedFindings.mechanism: Gas-equivalent minus electric cost is clamped to zero when negative, and nonpositive charging cost values are dropped before totaling. Negative savings or valid cost credits cannot survive this endpoint. Recap also hides nonpositive savings. Shared currency formatting itself can preserve signed values; the sign loss is upstream/domain policy.
confirmedFindings.narrowOwner: Year-review savings/net-cost sign policy owner, plus recap conditional copy only if the signed contract changes.
confirmedFindings.needs: Explicitly decide loss-versus-savings and valid-credit semantics; do not silently abs/clamp a signed raw value or change existing policy during QA.
confirmedFindings.evidenceLimit: Source clamping/filtering confirmed; whether persisted negative costs represent credits is a product/data-contract question, not asserted.

confirmedFindings.mechanism: AVG(start_soc_pct) filters start_soc_pct>0, excluding a physically valid 0% start from the denominator. No qualifying observation or a Scan/query failure leaves the same numeric zero shown by the plug-in SOC caption. Session count and SOC observation count are not the same denominator.

Comparisons are preformatted English, dollar-prefixed and nonlocalized numeric strings rendered verbatim. Catalog-key coverage for surrounding UI cannot localize those server-owned strings.
